title: CSS URL detection misclassified JavaScript URL objects

reproduction.source: const destination = new URL('https://docs.example.test/guide'); return Read the guide;
reproduction.beforeFix: The broad case-insensitive url(...) regex treated new URL(...) as a remote CSS asset and returned fail.
reproduction.afterFix: The link-only example returns pass; remote URL objects used as image sources remain rejected by AST resolution.

rootCause: The CSS url() matcher also matched JavaScript URL constructors.
remediation: Match CSS remote url(https://...) syntax separately from JavaScript new URL(...) and resolve URL object values only at network-loading sinks.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "URL object used only"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: external navigation was rejected
